name: Adam's apple enhancement
lead: Adam's apple enhancement, sometimes called laryngeal or tracheal augmentation, is a surgical procedure that enlarges the visible bump at the front of the neck. A more pronounced laryngeal prominence is a typically masculine neck feature, so the procedure is used to give the neck more definition and a more masculine profile alongside the jaw and chin. [1] It is described in the medical literature mainly as one component of facial masculinization surgery for transmasculine patients, alongside mandible angle and chin procedures. [2]

Wikipedia notes that transgender men may enlarge the prominence through masculinization surgery, and that testosterone therapy, which also enlarges the larynx and lowers voice pitch, is far more common than surgery. [1] Published evidence on augmentation is limited to small surgical series; one 2025 report followed six transmasculine patients who received personalized PEEK implants planned with virtual surgical planning. [2]

Within looksmaxxing communities the topic appears as a hardmaxxing option for a more masculine neck, though no community-specific studies were found. The opposite procedure, reduction (chondrolaryngoplasty or tracheal shave), is better documented and is often chosen by transgender women. [1][3]

paras: The Adam's apple is the protrusion formed by the angle of the thyroid cartilage around the larynx. Everyone with typical anatomy has one, but it is usually more visible in men, because testosterone-driven laryngeal growth in puberty moves the prominence forward. [1]

Prominence varies between people and depends largely on the size of the thyroid cartilage and larynx, which hormones shape. In women the prominence sits on the upper edge of the cartilage and the larynx is generally smaller, so it is less visible. [1]

In the literature found, augmentation is grouped under facial masculinization surgery for transmasculine patients, with mandible angle, chin and tracheal augmentation. [2] A 2025 study described patient-specific PEEK implants created from preoperative scans using virtual surgical planning. [2] The Wikipedia article on the laryngeal prominence notes that some transgender men choose augmentation, while testosterone therapy can also enlarge the larynx and is described as much more common than surgery. [1]

Chondrolaryngoplasty, or tracheal shave, reduces the prominence and aims to avoid a visible scar; Wikipedia reports surgeon series with few, usually transient, complications and notes risks to the vocal cords and epiglottis in the procedure family. [1][3] Feminization laryngoplasty goes further and operates on the vocal cords, with a strong effect on the voice. [1] Augmentation is the converse operation and is far less often reported. [1]

The procedure is discussed as a possible way to add masculine neck definition within hardmaxxing conversations about the jaw, chin and neck. Published information about its outcomes comes from the clinical series above rather than from community sources.

card.summary: Surgical enlargement of the Adam's apple, documented mostly in transmasculine facial masculinization; evidence is a handful of small case series.
card.note: Surgery near the larynx; only small case series published.

quick.overview:
Adam's apple enhancement enlarges the bump at the front of the neck, usually with a custom implant or cartilage work, to give a more masculine neckline.

It appears in the literature chiefly as part of facial masculinization surgery for transmasculine patients. Published data are small series.
quick.mechanism: A surgeon adds volume over the thyroid cartilage, in the reported case series using a patient-specific PEEK implant designed from scans.
quick.risks: As with any surgery near the larynx, complications are possible; the reported series is only six patients, so rates are not established.

chain: Implant or cartilage work adds volume over the thyroid cartilage
Neck shows a more prominent laryngeal bump
Neck and profile read as more masculine
angle.text: The procedure makes the Adam's apple more visible, which people seek to give the front of the neck a more masculine contour that complements a defined jaw and chin.
